source: master-asbuilt.json; geometry from STABLE customers only; no rulebook consulted

method.hull: convex hull of STABLE customers (per tech, and per tech x weekday)
method.overlap: 10 nearest STABLE neighbours; flagged when the runner-up tech holds >= 3 of them
method.seam: pairs of assigned customers within 1.5 km belonging to different techs (or, within a tech, different weekdays); STABLE-only customers are too sparse for this radius, so a stable-only tier at 3 km is reported separately
method.cluster: 2.5 km greedy clustering of seam customers, described by their cities and streets
method.zip: dominance by job count, not visit count
